description: A distortion built by solving a nonlinear circuit equation one sample at a time, so the shape depends on what came before it

params.text: Multiplies the input before the distortion, from unity at its minimum to 26 times at its maximum
Scales the step the solver takes each sample, from 0.5 to 2, which sets how hard the distortion bites

outputs.text: The distorted signal, hard clipped and scaled to ±5V

notes: the three lamps read the level after the DRIVE knob and before the distortion: the blue one fades out as that level reaches 4.5V, the green one comes up above 4.5V and the red one above 18V.
the maker's tooltips call the two knobs Snore amount and Dream amount, where the panel prints DRIVE and DISTORT.
menu: Oversample x2 — runs the solver at twice the sample rate, which is where it starts
Oversample x4 — runs the solver at four times the sample rate
